title: Replace a vehicle's registration certificate online
summary: You can apply online to replace a lost, stolen, or destroyed paper registration certificate for a NSW registered vehicle.
intro:
If you’re the owner of a NSW registered vehicle and your registration certificate has been lost, stolen, or destroyed, you can apply for a paper replacement online.

You’ll receive the replacement paper certificate within 7 business days. If you need it sooner, you can:

Note: Ordering replacement registration documents does not renew your rego or extend its expiry date. If your registration is due to expire within 6 weeks, consider renewing it online before ordering a replacement.
who_can_apply: The recorded owner of the NSW registered vehicle can apply online.

You cannot apply online and must visit a service centre if: you are not recorded as the owner of the registered vehicle, you do not have a NSW Driver Licence or NSW Photo Card, the vehicle is registered in a company name, or the registration has expired.
what_you_need: Your NSW Driver Licence or NSW Photo Card details
A copy of the Replacement Application form (https://tfnswforms.transport.nsw.gov.au/45070182-replacement-application.pdf)

how_to_steps.text: Log in or create your MyServiceNSW Account, or continue as a guest.
Follow the prompts to replace a registration certificate.
Keep a copy of the receipt for your records.
Download and complete the form Replacement Application.
Submit your application in person at a service centre.

faqs.q: How long will it take to receive the replacement certificate?
faqs.a: You will receive the replacement paper certificate within 7 business days.

faqs.q: Does ordering a replacement certificate renew my registration?
faqs.a: No, ordering replacement registration documents does not renew your rego or extend its expiry date.

faqs.q: What should I do if my registration expires soon?
faqs.a: If your registration is due to expire within 6 weeks, consider renewing it online before ordering a replacement.
